n: Parley P. Pratt, a former Campbellite preacher converted by the Book of Mormon in 1830, is called to preach, learn from Christ, and be meek and humble.

f.g: an energetic missionary, writer, and later apostle.

n: He is to join Oliver Cowdery and Peter Whitmer Jr. on the mission to the Lamanites in the western “wilderness.” On the way, they converted many in Kirtland, Ohio.

f.w: into the wilderness among the Lamanites

n: Ziba Peterson will also go. Christ himself will be with them as their advocate, and nothing will overpower them.

f.w: I myself will go with them and be in their midst

n: They must follow the written scriptures, claim no other revelation, and pray always for understanding.

f.g: “pretend” = claim; they should not claim new revelations for the Church.

n: If they take these words seriously and don’t treat them lightly, they will be blessed.
